judgments.reason: Zhou et al. 2021 reports the seven-session motor-imagery experiment on 20 healthy subjects. The dataset matches its authors, session count and participant count, and the dataset DOI is this paper.
judgments.paper_title: Relative Power Correlates With the Decoding Performance of Motor Imagery Both Across Time and Subjects

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS; used for formatting this dataset, not a paper describing the Zhou 2021 motor imagery data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data, a standard used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing the Zhou 2021 motor imagery data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
